name: tin
description: Codex hooks that keep a project's working context across compaction and new sessions.

interface.longDescription: Codex hooks for one project's context. At a context threshold tin asks the agent to write the project's own documents; at session start it hands those paths back with how stale each one is. tin stores no content itself -- the documents are yours and the agent writes them.
interface.defaultPrompt: Configure tin's context documents for this project and show tin --help.
